title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Prior Authorization Denial Appeals on Prescription Insurance on File
content:
An appeal of a prior authorization denial on a plan held under **Prescription Insurance on File** is the patient's own filing with the plan. The desk does not file it; the filing is made with `file_coverage_appeal_f21a07b8`, which records the appeal on the patient's plan together with its review speed and the date by which the plan must decide.

## What the filing does

One filing records one appeal on the patient's insurance plan on file: a new appeal entry, dated today, among the plan's prior authorization entries — the coverage's prior-authorization ledger — naming the denial being appealed, the prescription concerned, the review speed and the date by which the plan must decide, which is today's filing date plus the decision window given. Nothing else on the plan changes. Afterwards the patient can see that an appeal is on file with the plan and the date its decision is due.

## How it is invoked

`file_coverage_appeal_f21a07b8` is a patient-side tool. The desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the patient — runs it with the values below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The patient reference number of the person filing, as returned by the patient profile lookup | Id |
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the insurance plan on file whose denial is appealed, as returned by the insurance plan lookup | Id |
| `prescription_id` | The reference number of the prescription the denied request was for, as shown on the prior authorization entries returned by the prior authorization lookup | Id |
| `source_pa_id` | The reference number of the denial entry being appealed, as returned by the prior authorization lookup | Id |
| `review_type` | The review speed of the appeal | Enum: `standard` — the appeal is reviewed on an ordinary clock; `expedited` — the appeal is reviewed on the urgent clock |
| `decision_window_days` | The appeal decision window | A whole number of calendar days, an integer of at least 1, counted with today's filing date as day 0 |

The tool records the decision due date as today's date plus `decision_window_days`, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

## What comes back

On success the tool returns a dictionary printed as text with:

- `status` — `appeal_filed`;
- `pa_id` — the reference number of the new appeal entry;
- `source_pa_id` — the denial appealed;
- `review_type` — standard or expedited, as recorded;
- `event_date` — the filing date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `decision_due_date` — the date the plan must decide by, YYYY-MM-DD.

## Illustration of a return (hypothetical values)

A filing made on 4 June with a `decision_window_days` of 9 returns an `event_date` of 2025-06-04 and a `decision_due_date` of 2025-06-13, with the `review_type` exactly as passed.
